top.naslov: Observer reads the moves of the maxima as news, but the PM10 top moved only from 20 to 23 [F5], NO2 from 68 to 71 [F7] and PM2.5 from 14 to 19 [F9], and the record holds 0 days to say what is usual [F47]. The small model itself rated these connections lowest in surprise [F51], and the maxima come from single stations, so the rank change to Leštane [F4] says nothing about the city. Note also that the source labels local time as Z, so the hour stamps are shaky [F3].

top.naslov: Konektorovi maksimumi u padu više ne opisuju ono što je stiglo: između sati sa oznakom izvora 12:00 i 13:00 najviša vrednost PM10 pomerila se sa 20 na 23, PM2.5 sa 14 na 19, a NO2 sa 68 na 71 µg/m³, i nema osnovice po kojoj bih išta od toga nazvao neuobičajenim. Stojčino brdo više nije na vrhu: Leštane sada drži maksimum PM10, Zemun Ugrinovačka maksimum PM2.5, a Bulevar despota Stefana maksimum NO2, dok je Pančevo Sodara najniža za sve njih.
